fusions.name: Bar by Bar
fusions.desc: Sends an iron bar that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 25% chance to leave it [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Muzzled Menagerie
fusions.desc: Locks every enemy within 4 tiles in bars, which deals 26 damage and leaves them [Suppressed] for 5 seconds, their auras smothered and their abilities out of reach. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 4% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Everything Stays Put
fusions.desc: After a 1-second cast, holds every creature within 5 tiles in place for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Lock and Lean
fusions.desc: Each time you afflict something, you gain a shield worth 10% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
